basisStatement: Tie the imported contracts-core schema bundle hash to the immutable PostgreSQL control-store target version so release evidence and datastore evolution cannot drift apart.
subtitle: Immutable migration numbering, PostgreSQL singleton locking, reader-window governance, and resumable backfill posture in one observatory.

timelineRows.backfillSummary: Backfill policy seeded but not yet started.
timelineRows.compatibilityBandLabel: Window remains open while the new reader shape is only planned.
timelineRows.summary: Next expand-only change is staged behind the singleton lock and release-candidate binding.

timelineRows.backfillSummary: DDL in progress under a transaction-scoped advisory lock.
timelineRows.compatibilityBandLabel: Previous readers remain supported while structural writes are still applying.
timelineRows.summary: Structural change is underway but not yet verified, so release admission remains blocked.

timelineRows.backfillSummary: Backfill complete and waiting on verification evidence.
timelineRows.compatibilityBandLabel: Compatibility window stays open until replay and restore verification turn green.
timelineRows.summary: Verification is active and the platform is still within the rollback-safe reader window.

timelineRows.backfillSummary: Backfill complete; destructive cleanup is now allowed.
timelineRows.compatibilityBandLabel: Compatibility band closed after verification, so fail-forward posture is mandatory.
timelineRows.summary: Legacy shape removal began only after the compatibility window closed and fail-forward posture became explicit.

timelineRows.backfillSummary: Resumable backfill halted after partial progress; no destructive cleanup started.
timelineRows.compatibilityBandLabel: Compatibility window remains open because historical readers still depend on the prior shape.
timelineRows.summary: The framework records halted posture explicitly so backfill can resume without mutating prior evidence.

timelineRows.backfillSummary: Backfill failed after the compatibility window closed.
timelineRows.compatibilityBandLabel: Compatibility window already closed, so compensating release lineage is required.
timelineRows.summary: Failure is queryable truth, and fail-forward ownership is no longer optional once the window closes.

timelineRows.backfillSummary: Baseline migration carries no backfill requirement.
timelineRows.compatibilityBandLabel: The current baseline still exposes a compatible reader window for protected history.
timelineRows.summary: The imported contracts-core bundle is pinned to the current baseline target version.
